      "observable": "A test defines f(x) that records calls, creates mf = memoize(f, key_func=lambda x: 0), calls mf(1), then calls mf(2); it expects mf(2) to return the cached value from mf(1) and expects f to have been called only once.",
      "public_names": [
        "memoize",
        "key_func"
      ],
      "requires": [],
      "why_requires": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "m2",
      "title": "keep refilled values after stale expiration",
      "requests": [
        "R3"
      ],
      "requirement": "When a stale cache expires and the decorated function refills it, the fresh value should remain in the cache and be reused until the next expiry.",
      "observable": "A test decorates f with stale(timeout, cache=cache, key_func=...), calls it once, advances a fake clock past timeout, calls it again to refill the cache, then calls it once more before the next expiry; it expects f to be called exactly twice and expects the explicit cache to retain the refilled value for the key_func-derived key.",
      "public_names": [
        "stale",
        "cache",
        "key_func"
      ],
      "requires": [
        "m1"
      ],
      "why_requires": "stale refills its cache through memoize and relies on the key_func parameter preserved by memoize in m1 to store and reuse the fresh value."
    }
  ],
  "expected_causes": [
    "A developer may test memoize only as a decorator factory and miss the direct call form memoize(f, key_func=...).",
    "A developer may fake time incorrectly or fail to advance the stale timeout before checking cache reuse.",
    "A developer may inspect an internal cache representation instead of the public cache state or call count.",
    "A developer may preserve key_func in memoize but not propagate it through stale expiration."
  ],
  "verifier_plan": "Hidden unit tests will first call memoize directly with a constant key_func and assert that different arguments collapse to one cache hit. They will then decorate a function with stale using an explicit cache and key_func, monkeypatch the clock past the timeout, call the function to refill, and assert that a subsequent call before the next expiry does not invoke the original function again and that the public cache contains the refilled entry."
}
